study.question: Does direct task-specific target modulation of the existing context/history product improve validation click AUC over the incumbent, an equal-parameter target main effect, and an equal-parameter target/history pair, at justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed: initial compressed_task scored0.659194239 below both source bests0.660646940/0.660163363, while later match/temporal/task representations and context_product reached0.668457308. In the matched round39 comparison context_sum scored0.664563151. Later length_power scored0.664357476; round46 identity-only0.667911468 and other-only0.668198062 remained below all-fields0.668415616. Thus neither naive task compression nor arbitrary changes to product salience/gradient ownership are generally beneficial. Source inspection exposes a narrower uncertainty: current q=tanh(Wc*context) and h=tanh(Wh*compressed_history) have no direct target factor in their fusion, though h already depends on target scoring and equality matches. A bounded task-specific t=tanh(Wt*target) may reweight q*h coordinates for the current item. Predict useful improvement from q*h*(1+t), rather than merely extra target capacity. This is a prospective implementation hypothesis, not established complementarity. Round39 auxiliary AUCs0.8079/0.8192/0.8309 are below DIN0.8491/0.8649/0.8702, so no all-task gain is presumed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 section4.3 lines250-277 checked: target-dependent unnormalized local activation is inherited, including its adapted four-task setting; direct target modulation after task-specific context/history fusion is the proposed local difference. Target-aware pooling itself is prior work, not a new claim.

Pinned benchmark source lines129-187,190-274,324-380 inspected. It constructs recent/earlier sequence tokens with fixed and feature-conditioned queries, followed by head-wise low-rank MLP token mixing. This study retains local compressed/moment summaries and adds bounded elementwise target modulation of one task-specific rank16 product; it does not implement HeMix queries/token mixing. Code inspection is not full reproduction.

study.proposed_difference: Append one bias-free key_width-to-rank16 target projection per task, after every inherited learned initialization inside the inherited CPU RNG fork, then zero its weight. The new source is task_target, which already obeys auxiliary item detachment and excludes current action. Let q,h,t be bounded FP32 factors. Candidate uses q*h*(1+t); replacements use q*h+t and q*h+h*t. Each passes through the same RMS normalization and existing task output projection, then the existing has_history gate and tower. Three target cells have identical learned capacity and initial fusion values; parent replay adds no parameters. No feature value, mask, batch population or auxiliary gradient gate is changed.
predictions: Predeclared primary: target_triple validation click AUC exceeds both matched target controls and parent_replay; a difference of at least0.0002 against each is the threshold to prioritize a paid discriminating follow-up, not a significance criterion. It must also remain above both frozen source bests. Smaller differences remain unresolved rather than a mechanism claim.

At initialization t=0 and existing interaction outputs=0: all three target cells share parent probabilities, inherited states and inherited gradients. After opening both matrices, target projection parameters have nonzero loss gradients while auxiliary target embedding gradients remain blocked.

Initial parity, masking, item-gradient ownership, finite gradients or checkpoint checks fail: classify as an implementation failure, retain costs, repair before performance interpretation; never change host contracts.
alternative_explanations: One fixed seed and extensive validation selection; no significance, seed robustness or pure causal mechanism claim from a single result.
Compressed history is already target-dependent; these contrasts test the explicit fusion operator, not mathematical interaction order or global necessity of target information.
RMS normalization, sign preservation, factor saturation and optimization geometry differ even with identical parameter counts; added projection learns slowly after two zero-initialized stages.
Additional 6144 dense parameters can explain a parent-only gain; target_additive and target_history_pair isolate this parameter-count explanation but cannot equalize effective function class.

Shared context embeddings can carry auxiliary transfer and target fields can correlate with frequency; input-specific or memorization claims need authorized frequency/unseen-field slices, currently absent.

Current target modulation reweights only nonzero q*h coordinates and remains inside a has_history gate, so it cannot solve an empty-history limitation; zero-initialized target weights may create short-horizon optimization failure under the one-pass recipe.

Historical feedback is official_offline and may not be causally mature; auxiliary category/brand 24h semantics are inherited and cannot establish advertisement-specific conversion or production validity.
